tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// thub pa'i bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri med dad pa'i chu gter las 'khrungs pa// tshig gi me tog snyan pa'i dri bsung can// ngag gi srad bus tshar du dngar byas nas// thub dbang yon tan rgya mtshor mchod par bgyi// 'gro ba 'di kun sna tshogs sdug bsngal gyis// kun nas gzir bar gang gis mkhyen gyur pas// de dag bsgral phyir byang chub thugs bskyed pa// phan par dgongs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa'i bde la kun nas ma zhen par// byang chub mchog phyir rab tu brtson pa yis// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab rdzogs mdzad pa// brtson pa mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ma chags nyes med mi 'khrugs rab tu sdud// rnam par mi g.yeng kun nas ma rmongs dang*// thabs stobs smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs// yongs su rdzogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dran dang brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul rkang pa dang*// dbang po mchog dang rmad du byung ba'i stobs// byang chub yan lag 'phags pa'i lam rnams kun// legs par grub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// grangs med gsum gyis sa bcu mthar phyin nas// lha rnams gdul bar bya phyir dga' ldan du// dam pa tog dkar zhes byar gang gyur pa// bsod nams mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus mkhyen khyod ni lhums su bde bar zhugs// lhums nas bltams shing gzhon nu'i rol rtsod mdzad// mngon par byung nas dka' ba rab tu spyad// don kun grub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub shing dbang drung du bdud kyi stobs// byams pa'i thugs kyis legs par pham mdzad nas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyis dbang bskur ba// dpa' bo chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mngon par shes pa lnga ni legs bsgrubs nas// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin mchog gis ni// bla na med pa'i byang chub brnyes gyur pa// 'jig rten 'dren pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bag chags dang bcas dri ma kun spangs shing*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun nas rab rgyas pas// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs gyur pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i rang bzhin can// nges pa lnga ldan bde chen ye shes sku// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis sna tshogs kun snang ba// sku gsum brnyes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lhun po'i rgyal po lta bur rab tu brjid// nyi ma bzhin du mtha' yas 'od mdzad cing*// mtshan dang dpe byad kun nas gsal ba'i sku// mgon po mtshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// don bzang chos spobs nges pa'i tshig ldan pas// 'khor gyi nang du 'jigs bral seng ge'i sgra// dbyangs kyi yan gal drug cus rab brgyan pa// kun tu sgrogs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gsal zhing thogs med mi gnas mnyam pa nyid// yon tan 'byung gnas gdul bya'i don kun sgrub// rtog pa kun spangs srid dang zhi ba'i bdag

/ye shes lnga ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten slob ma bse ru lta bu dang*// rgyal sras rnams dang thun mong gyur ba dang*// phul du byung ba'i yon tan kun brnyes pa// srid zhi'i ston mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// kun sbyor 'ching ba kun las rnam grol yang*// smon lam grub pa rnam 'phrul mtha' yas kyis// srid pa ji srid 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// skye dgu'i gnyen gcig khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo rin chen dam pa skor mdzad cing*// shin tu gdul dka'i skye bo rab tu btul// gdul bya rnam grol gsum la 'god mdzad pa// stobs bcu ldan pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gdul bya rnams kyi skal ba'i dus mkhyen nas// bstan pa 'phags pa'i tshogs la legs gtad de// ku sha'i grong du zhi ba'i tshul bstan pa// sdug bsngal mthar mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// slar yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams spel bya'i phyir// sku gdung ring bsrel phung por legs gyur nas// 'jig rten kun gyi mchod pa'i rten gyur pa// mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad la phyag 'tshal lo// sum cu rtsa gsum gandha ra yi grong*// ka liṅga dang klu yi gnas rnams su// bsod nams rten du nyid kyis rjes gnang ba'i// thub chen mche ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams shugs ldan snying rje'i ngang tshul can// go pi la yi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// 'gro ba gdul phyir nye bar byon gyur pa// rgyal ba'i tshems la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nyi mas lus 'phags snang byas nas// 'dzam gling snang bar byed ltar 'jang gi yul// snang bar mdzad nas 'dir ni snang mdzad pa// skye dgu'i sgron ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser ltar rab tu dwangs// kunda ltar dkar gur gum mdangs ldan pas// mdzes pa gzhan kun rab tu zil gnon pa// mchod par 'os pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs yon tan rgya mtshor skye ba brnyes// phan bde'i 'od zer sna tshogs rab tu 'phro// gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// dbang gi rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo// slar yang bdag la gsol ba'i tshig 'ga' mchis// 'jig rten mgon po yud tsam dgongs su gsol// mgon med 'di dag nga yis bskyab bo zhes// dam bcas ji bzhin nyid kyi rjes dgongs la// las kyi rlung gis srid pa'i rgya mtshor 'phangs// blo gros mig bral nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// 'gro kun sdug bsngal rnams las bskyab pa dang*// rnam grol bde chen thob par mdzad du gsol// khyod kyi bstan pa dri med tshul 'di ni// 'gro ba kun gyi mig gcig gyur pa lags// de lta mod kyi blo ngan ma sbyangs shing*// gzu lums smra ba chos ltar bcos pa yis// skye bo rnams kyis rab tu dkrugs par gyur// tshul 'di mgon po khyod kyis rab bzlog nas// bde gshegs bstan pa rma med rgyas pa dang*// 'gro ba kun la rtag tu snang bar mdzod// deng sang 'di na 'gro ba'i dpal 'byor dang*// thub pa'i bstan pa gang la brten pa'i gzhi// mong go rgyal po mi dbang go pe la// sku mched yab sras brgyud par bcas pa kun// sku tshe ring zhing dbang phyug rgyas pa dang*// thub dbang khyod kyi gsung rab bdud rtsi yi// snod kyi dam pa nyid du 'gyur ba dang*// chos bzhin 'jig rten rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// char chu dus su 'bab cing lo tog legs// nad dang mu ge 'khrug pa zhi ba dang*// phan tshun byams pa'i sems dang rab tu ldan// 'gro ba dpal dang ldan par mdzad du gsol// bde gshegs dbang po yon tan gter gyis phyug

/mtha' yas phyir na mtha' dag sus brjod spobs// gsol ba 'di dag bdag 'dra'i spyod yul min// 'on kyang cung zad tsam zhig 'dir brjod pas// rgyal sras go pe la yi dad pa'i mthus// thub chen mche ba mthong bar gyur pa la// rab tu dga' zhing dad pa'i dbang gis brjod// bdag blo'i nyes pa deng 'dir bzod par gsol// de las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ni// dri med rab tu dkar ba gang yod des// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang la gnas shog /gnas skabs su yang mi dbang go pe la// sras dang btsun mo nad med sku tshe ring*// bde gshegs bstan pa rgyas par byed pa dang*// byams pa'i thugs kyis 'gro ba skyong bar shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du// bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa legs bzung nas// chos kyis phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la// mtshungs med chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par shog /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer can// shes bya'i mkha' la kun tu thogs med cing*// gdul bya'i blo gros pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa// chos rje chos kyi nyi ma la phyag 'tshal// shākya'i rgyal po'i yon tan gyi cha la bstod cing gsol ba'i tshig 'di ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i gsung gi 'od zer gyis yid kyi mun pa bsal bar byas pas/ thub pa'i gsung rab kyi cha la blo'i snang ba cung zad thob par gyur pa chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pa zhes bya bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba mthong bar gyur pa la dad cing mngon par dga' bas/ shing pho stag gi lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum la sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
